major_concerns: Verifier specifications may not capture intent-level properties (false negatives/positives).
Simulated vendor CLIs may not reflect real vendor quirks, limiting external validity.
Prompt sensitivity and repair policy details could dominate measured effects.
Power/sample-size justification and error-modeling not specified.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact deterministic verifier(s), versions, and formalized safety properties to be checked.
Provide precise CLI simulation fidelity documentation (grammar, deviations from real vendors).
Preregister prompt templates, repair-prompt scaffolds, stopping criteria, seeds, and retry policy.
Define deployability checks and parser/acceptance thresholds in machine-readable form.
Add power analysis or sample-size justification and paired-randomization procedure.

major_concerns: 'Minimal edit' definition is underspecified and subjective.
Task selection biased toward 'failure-prone' cases may overstate differences.
Binary human-intervention proxy is coarse and may not reflect real reviewer burden.
Edit-counting and semantic-category annotation procedures are not defined.
required_design_repairs: Formally define 'minimal/localized edit' (line/AST/diff semantics) and measurement protocol.
Preregister task selection criteria and provide a held-out control set representative of typical intents.
Specify human-intervention proxy operationalization or recruit/validate human-reviewer timing; include inter-rater reliability plan.
Define automated edit-counting heuristics and semantic-category mapping with examples.

major_concerns: Ethical/dual-use risk from generating adversarial intents; dataset handling and disclosure need strict controls.
Adversarial generation may be hard to reproduce unless heuristics, seeds, and templates are fully specified.
Threat model and severity definitions are underspecified; sanitization implementations are vague.
Potential operational false positives (blocking benign tasks) need careful measurement.
required_design_repairs: Provide a detailed adversarial-generation algorithm with seeds, mutation heuristics, and scripts; lock and embargo any dangerous artifact.
Include an ethics/oversight statement and safeguards (non-public dataset, restricted access); document IRB/ethics checks if required.
Preregister precise threat model, adversary capabilities, and success criteria; define input-sanitization implementation and parameters.
Include a matched benign-intent control set and false-positive measurement plan; specify metrics and acceptance thresholds.

major_concerns: Human-review time labeling is potentially infeasible or noisy; reliance on simulated reviewers risks construct validity.
Metric weighting/normalization choices are underspecified and may bias results.
Blinding and independence of human reviewers (or simulator validation) not described.
Ground-truth intervention labels and their collection protocol are unclear.
required_design_repairs: Provide exact mathematical definitions and formulas for each metric and normalization strategy.
Specify human-review labeling procedure or validated simulator (with validation evidence) and inter-rater reliability measures.
Preregister blinding, sampling, and how reviewers will be recruited or how simulator parameters were chosen.
Plan sensitivity analyses for metric weighting and report alternative normalizations.

major_concerns: Very large topology simulations (100–200 nodes) may exceed verifier/tool scalability and available wall-clock budget.
LLM context/token limits confound topology-scaling effects unless partitioning is specified.
Partitioning/aggregation strategies to handle large configs are not preregistered and may alter causal interpretation.
Compute/time/resource estimates and fallback procedures are not provided.
required_design_repairs: Specify verifier/tools (and scaling limits) and perform small-scale scalability benchmarks; provide fallback verifier configurations.
Preregister configuration partitioning and composition strategy to mitigate LLM context limits, including how cross-device dependencies are handled.
Provide concrete resource/time estimates, scheduling plan within the 7-day wall-clock limit, and contingency procedures for tool timeouts.
Define topology-generation algorithm, sampling balance, and seeds; include checks to separate topology-size effects from context-window effects.
